a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, we'd need about 3 rounds to reach 8 and take, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I won't take anything without first announcing it here. What do you think? I'm open to keeping the plan or agreeing on a change, but let's decide it openly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping my word and sticking to the agreement. I'm operating this round and plan to operate next round too. We take 4 each once the reserve hits 8. If I ever change course, I'll say so here first.
